items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: with Wes Montgomery and people like Paul Desmond

ctx.x: They could write anything you see. So I felt good about that I was part of that community that had, again, those eclectic tastes. And so I just wanted to continue that. My big idol when I was a teenager was Herbie. Because again, the fact that he was with Miles and then doing all these like CTI, and them dates, with Wes Montgomery and people like Paul Desmond. I said I want to do that. That’s what I want to do. He’s playing all this hip stuff over here and then working with Miles, and then doing his own albums.…
